> 第19章 驱虎吞狼（第1页）
“梦星前辈，那我现在该怎么办？”
两名武师高手，可不是他这个级别能够应对的。
梦星道：“这两人距离你也就一里之遥，以你的速度不可能跟他们相比，你现在唯一的办法，就是依靠妖兽把他们两个缠住，然后你趁机脱身。”
苏辰苦笑起来：“梦星前辈，你说的倒是轻巧，我初来乍到，怎么知道哪里有妖兽，一个不好，别说借助妖兽帮我抵挡强敌，估计自己就先死在妖兽口中了。”
梦星道：“这点你倒不用担心，我已经为你找好了路线，在你右前方三里距离的一个峡谷里面，有着一头三阶妖兽赤睛白虎，此时正是守护伴生灵药‘血魅花’的关键时期。
你冲过去，如果成功的话，不但有可能摆脱了身后的追兵，还有机会把那株伴生灵药夺走，提升你的元力。”
苏辰的双目顿时亮了起来，但又讷讷的问道：“如果失败了呢？”
“失败的话，你就葬身虎口，成为伴生灵药的肥料。”
苏辰无语过后，神色又转为了坚定。
既然已经无路可走，那不如赌上一把，成功了自己吸收这株伴生灵药，失败了，就让这株伴生灵药吸收自己！
苏辰不动声色，朝着梦星所指引的位置走去。
在苏辰身后不远处的位置，两道身着黑衣的身影始终跟着苏辰前行，寸步不离。
“这小子应该没察觉到咱们，再深入一点，就要了他的小命！”
“好，再让他多活一段时……不好！
他们注意到，苏辰行走了一段时间之后，骤然开始加速，朝着前方疾驰而去。
两名林家武者见行踪败露，当即也不再掩饰，怒喝出声，两人武师级别的元力猛然爆发，速度提升到极致，如同利箭一般的朝着苏辰追杀而去！
苏辰听到身后越来越近的破风声，心中猛地一沉。
这两人都是武师，比他高出了两个大境界，速度也是他的数倍，双方之间的距离被快速拉近。

不过苏辰并没有慌乱，这一切都在他的计划之中。
“小子，别挣扎了，你区区武徒，能逃过我们的追杀，简直是痴人说梦！”
双方的距离不断拉近，很快，便只有了十丈之遥。
而此时，苏辰纵深一跃，冲进了一个峡谷之中。
这是一个并不宽阔，约莫只是十丈长，三丈宽的峡谷。
峡谷中央位置，有着一株灵药，三寸高度，枝叶翠绿欲滴，但花朵却足有巴掌大小，猩红无比，散发着一股恶臭的气味。
在峡谷底部趴着一头足有一丈身高的白色虎类妖兽，赫然便是梦星所说的三阶妖兽，赤睛白虎。
在苏辰冲过来后，这头赤睛白虎也睁开了血红色的眼睛，朝着苏辰打量起来，巨大的身躯陡然站了起来，抖了抖浑身雪白的毛发，杀意凛然。
三阶妖兽已经有了一定的灵智，也能感受到苏辰的实力。
赤睛白虎怎么也没有想到，像苏辰这么弱小的人类，竟然也敢闯入自己的领地。
“哈哈哈，小子，你无路可逃了吧！”
两名林家武师见苏辰闯入绝地，便是哈哈大笑起来，纷纷落入峡谷之中。
但两人迎面看到的，却是一头暴怒的赤睛白虎。

The latest chapter of Taishang Martial God Art_Chapter 19: Driving Tigers and Swallowing Wolves Page 1_The Taishang Martial God Art is a cute primary school student_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 19: Driving the tiger and swallowing the wolf (page 1)
"Senior Mengxing, what should I do now?"
Two martial arts masters were not something he could handle at his level.
Mengxing said: "These two people are only one mile away from you. With your speed, it is impossible to compare with them. Your only way now is to rely on monsters to entangle them two, and then you can take the opportunity to escape."
Su Chen smiled bitterly: "Senior Mengxing, what you said is easy. I am new here, how do I know where the monsters are? If I am not good, let alone using the monsters to help me resist strong enemies, I will probably die in the mouth of the monster first."
Mengxing said: "You don't have to worry about this. I have already found a route for you. In a canyon three miles ahead of you to your right, there is a third-order monster beast, a red-eyed white tiger. This is the critical period for guarding the companion elixir 'Blood Charm Flower'.
You rush over. If you succeed, you may not only get rid of the pursuers behind you, but also have the opportunity to take away the companion elixir and increase your energy. "
Su Chen's eyes suddenly lit up, but he asked calmly: "What if it fails?"
"If you fail, you will die in the tiger's mouth and become fertilizer for the accompanying elixir."
After Su Chen was speechless, his expression turned firm again.
Since there is no way out, it is better to take a gamble and absorb this companion elixir yourself if you succeed. If you fail, let this companion elixir absorb you!
Su Chen remained calm and walked towards the location pointed by Mengxing.
Not far behind Su Chen, two figures dressed in black followed Su Chen, never leaving.
"This kid probably didn't notice us. If we go deeper, it will kill him!"
"Okay, let him live a little longer...not good!
They noticed that after Su Chen had been walking for a while, he suddenly started to accelerate and galloped forward.
When the two Lin family warriors saw their whereabouts exposed, they immediately stopped covering up and shouted angrily. Their martial artist-level Yuanli suddenly burst out, their speed increased to the extreme, and they chased Su Chen like sharp arrows!
Su Chen's heart suddenly sank when he heard the sound of breaking wind getting closer and closer behind him.
These two people are both martial arts masters, two realms higher than him, and their speed is several times that of him. The distance between the two parties is quickly shortened.
But Su Chen didn't panic, it was all according to his plan.
"Boy, stop struggling, you are just a martial arts disciple, it is simply a fantasy that you can escape our pursuit! "
The distance between the two sides kept getting closer, and soon, they were only ten feet away.
At this time, Su Chen jumped deep and rushed into a canyon.
This is a canyon that is not wide, only about ten feet long and three feet wide.
In the center of the canyon, there is an elixir plant, three inches tall, with green branches and leaves, but the flowers are the size of a palm, extremely scarlet, and exudes a foul smell.
Lying at the bottom of the canyon was a white tiger-like monster that was about one foot tall. It was the third-order monster that Mengxing had mentioned, the red-eyed white tiger.
After Su Chen rushed over, the red-eyed white tiger also opened its blood-red eyes and looked at Su Chen. The huge body suddenly stood up, shaking its snow-white hair, with murderous intent.
The third-level monster already has a certain amount of intelligence, and can also feel Su Chen's strength.
The red-eyed white tiger never thought that a weak human like Su Chen would dare to intrude into his territory.
"Hahaha, boy, you have no way to escape! "
When the two Lin family martial artists saw Su Chen breaking into the desperate situation, they burst out laughing and fell into the canyon one after another.
But what they saw face to face was a furious white tiger with red eyes.
